title: A kit still packed after the transfer
body: The first aid kit is sealed. On the clipboard, the destination line has been rubbed almost blank; a pencilled turn toward the river survives in the margin.
rival_reading: A crew protecting supplies during a suspected exposure could keep the kit sealed and change a route; the missing destination does not prove a containment order failed.
gloss: A sealed medical kit remains with a transfer sheet whose destination has been erased.

title: The bottle with soil in its cap
body: Fine brown grit clings beneath the bottle cap. One bandage is folded around the neck, clean on the outside and stained green at the edge.
rival_reading: Responders could wrap and rinse a water bottle after any emergency; soil and a plant stain could come from the route rather than an agricultural exposure.
gloss: Soil in a bottle cap and a stained bandage suggest contact with field material without identifying its source.
